# Arduino platform (specification 1.5) of the KIT SoC Lab Lab 3 SoC: NEORV32 v1.11
# rv32imc_zicsr, code at 0xE0000000 (ZedBoard XIP / KR260 BRAM), 16 KB DMEM.
# The compile and link flags are those of arduino/build.mk + ext/neorv32/sw/common/
# common.mk (the generator reads them from there), so a sketch builds to the same
# code as with 'make SKETCH=...'.
# https://arduino.github.io/arduino-cli/latest/platform-specification/

name=KIT SoC Lab NEORV32
version=0.3.0

# defaults of the board menu properties (boards.txt sets them)
build.arduino_sim=0
build.time_scale=1
build.sim_time_scale=1000
build.synth_voices=
build.effort=-Os
build.rom_size=64k

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- toolchain
# xPack GCC/GDB installed by Boards Manager toolsDependencies. For a manual clone,
# run python3 arduino/tools/install_board.py (latest stable, no sudo/PATH edits).
# A personal compiler override can still be supplied in platform.local.txt:
# a file platform.local.txt next to this one with the line
#   compiler.path=/home/<user>/opt/xpack-riscv-none-elf-gcc-15.2.0-1/bin/
# (with the trailing slash; Windows: C:/.../bin/), or for arduino-cli
#   arduino-cli compile --build-property compiler.path=/.../bin/ ...
compiler.path={runtime.tools.soclab-riscv-toolchain.path}/bin/
compiler.prefix=riscv-none-elf-
compiler.c.cmd={compiler.prefix}gcc
compiler.cpp.cmd={compiler.prefix}gcc
compiler.S.cmd={compiler.prefix}gcc
compiler.c.elf.cmd={compiler.prefix}gcc
compiler.ar.cmd={compiler.prefix}ar
compiler.objcopy.cmd={compiler.prefix}objcopy
compiler.size.cmd={compiler.prefix}size

# Python 3 (standard library only) for the .hex image (tools/bin2hex.py)
soclab.python={runtime.tools.soclab-python-runtime.path}/bin/python3
soclab.python.windows={runtime.tools.soclab-python-runtime.path}/python.exe

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- flags
# common.mk CC_OPTS with MARCH / MABI of build.mk, EFFORT = Optimize menu
compiler.neorv32.flags=-march=rv32imc_zicsr_zifencei -mabi=ilp32 {build.effort} -Wall -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -nostartfiles -mno-fdiv -mstrict-align -mbranch-cost=10 -ffp-contract=off -g
# build.mk USER_FLAGS: ARDUINO_SIM / ARDUINO_TIME_SCALE (Build and Time scale
# menus), SYNTH_VOICES (Synth voices menu; empty = the library default)
compiler.soclab.defines=-DARDUINO_SIM={build.arduino_sim} -DARDUINO_TIME_SCALE={build.time_scale} {build.synth_voices}
# linker part of CC_OPTS + USER_FLAGS (flash base and size, DMEM size)
compiler.neorv32.ldflags=-Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--defsym=__neorv32_rom_base=0xE0000000 -Wl,--defsym=__neorv32_rom_size={build.rom_size} -Wl,--defsym=__neorv32_ram_size=16k -Wl,--no-warn-rwx-segments
compiler.ldlibs=-lm -lc -lgcc
compiler.neorv32.include="-I{runtime.platform.path}/system/neorv32/sw/lib/include"
# ARDUINO as in cores/neorv32/Arduino.h (which defines it too)
compiler.arduino.defines=-DARDUINO=10819 -DARDUINO_{build.board} -DARDUINO_ARCH_{build.arch}

compiler.c.flags=-c {compiler.neorv32.flags} -std=gnu11 -MMD
compiler.cpp.flags=-c {compiler.neorv32.flags} -std=gnu++17 -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti -fno-threadsafe-statics -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables -MMD
compiler.S.flags=-c {compiler.neorv32.flags}
compiler.c.elf.flags={compiler.neorv32.flags} {compiler.neorv32.ldflags}
compiler.ar.flags=rcs

# The IDE's "Compiler warnings" setting. common.mk's -Wall is always on; "None"
# (-w) also silences the assembler. Above "None" every file with RAMFUNC code
# shows "Warning: setting incorrect section attributes for .data.ramfunc"
# (harmless; arduino/tools/rvcc.sh filters it in the make build).
compiler.warning_flags=-w
compiler.warning_flags.none=-w
compiler.warning_flags.default=
compiler.warning_flags.more=-Wall
compiler.warning_flags.all=-Wall -Wextra

# extra flags (like the Makefile's SKETCH_FLAGS: build.extra_flags reaches every
# compile, the NEORV32 library too, and the link)
build.extra_flags=
compiler.c.extra_flags=
compiler.cpp.extra_flags=
compiler.S.extra_flags=
compiler.c.elf.extra_flags=
compiler.ar.extra_flags=
compiler.libraries.ldflags=

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- compile
recipe.c.o.pattern="{compiler.path}{compiler.c.cmd}" {compiler.c.flags} {compiler.warning_flags} {compiler.arduino.defines} {compiler.soclab.defines} {build.extra_flags} {compiler.c.extra_flags} {compiler.neorv32.include} {includes} "{source_file}" -o "{object_file}"
recipe.cpp.o.pattern="{compiler.path}{compiler.cpp.cmd}" {compiler.cpp.flags} {compiler.warning_flags} {compiler.arduino.defines} {compiler.soclab.defines} {build.extra_flags} {compiler.cpp.extra_flags} {compiler.neorv32.include} {includes} "{source_file}" -o "{object_file}"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- link
# Patched linker script (build.mk: ". = ALIGN(4);" in front of __init_array_start /
# __fini_array_start), code at the SPI flash base 0xE000_0000. Input order as close
# to the Makefile's as arduino-cli allows: sketch and library objects, the whole
# core archive (every core object is linked, as the Makefile links them: also
# their constructors), the NEORV32 objects, crt0.
recipe.c.combine.pattern="{compiler.path}{compiler.c.elf.cmd}" {compiler.c.elf.flags} {compiler.warning_flags} {build.extra_flags} {compiler.c.elf.extra_flags} "-Wl,-Map={build.path}/{build.project_name}.map" -T "{runtime.platform.path}/system/neorv32/sw/common/neorv32_arduino.ld" {object_files} -Wl,--whole-archive "{archive_file_path}" -Wl,--no-whole-archive "{build.path}/neorv32_aux.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_cfs.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_clint.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_cpu.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_cpu_cfu.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_crc.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_dma.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_gpio.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_gptmr.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_neoled.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_newlib.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_onewire.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_pwm.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_rte.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_sdi.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_slink.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_smp.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_spi.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_trng.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_twd.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_twi.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_uart.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_wdt.c.o" "{build.path}/neorv32_xip.c.o" "{build.path}/crt0.S.o" {compiler.libraries.ldflags} {compiler.ldlibs} -o "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.elf"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- images
# <sketch>.ino.bin: SPI flash image from flash address 0 (= 0xE000_0000), the
# format of the course fw/sim images and of the Makefile's <sketch>.bin: .text,
# .rodata, then the .data load image (crt0 copies it from right behind .rodata).
# The LMA-based binary of the three sections is these bytes (build.mk checks it).
recipe.objcopy.bin.pattern="{compiler.path}{compiler.objcopy.cmd}" -O binary -j .text -j .rodata -j .data "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.elf" "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.bin"
# <sketch>.ino.hex: the image for labs/lab3/sim/tb_soc.v ($readmemh, one byte per line)
recipe.objcopy.hex.pattern="{soclab.python}" "{runtime.platform.path}/tools/bin2hex.py" "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.bin" -o "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.hex"

recipe.output.tmp_file={build.project_name}.bin
recipe.output.save_file={build.project_name}.{build.variant}.bin

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- size
# flash image = .text + .rodata + .data; DMEM = .data + .bss + .heap (the rest is stack)
recipe.size.pattern="{compiler.path}{compiler.size.cmd}" -A "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.elf"
recipe.size.regex=^(?:\.text|\.rodata|\.data)\s+([0-9]+).*
recipe.size.regex.data=^(?:\.data|\.bss|\.heap)\s+([0-9]+).*

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- upload
# Automated reset/run still needs a board check; manual GDB load + run worked.
# An OpenOCD server must already run (JTAG-HS2 on the extension board):
#   openocd -f <this folder>/tools/openocd_neorv32_jtaghs2.cfg
# GDB loads the ELF through the jtagspi flash bank at 0xE000_0000, then reset run
# starts the boot ROM, which enables XIP before jumping to the application.
# A plain resume at the ELF entry skips that initialization after a flash reset.
# reset run returns without waiting for the sketch to finish, so batch exits.
tools.gdb.path={compiler.path}
tools.gdb.cmd={compiler.prefix}gdb
# Fallback; Tools > OpenOCD target supplies the selected board menu value.
tools.gdb.server=127.0.0.1:3333
tools.gdb.upload.params.verbose=
tools.gdb.upload.params.quiet=-q
tools.gdb.upload.pattern="{path}{cmd}" -batch -nx {upload.verbose} -ex "set confirm off" -ex "target extended-remote {server}" -ex "load" -ex "monitor reset run" -ex "detach" "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.elf"

# Native UART loader requires the matching bootROM hardware image.
# Personal SSH address belongs in boards.local.txt.
tools.uartssh.ssh=ubuntu@192.0.2.1
tools.uartssh.device=/dev/ttyS0
tools.uartssh.resetaddress=0xA0030000
tools.uartssh.upload.params.verbose=
tools.uartssh.upload.params.quiet=
tools.uartssh.upload.pattern="{soclab.python}" "{runtime.platform.path}/tools/uart_upload.py" --bin "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.bin" --ssh "{ssh}" --device "{device}" --baud 115200 --reset-address {resetaddress} --ssh-sudo
tools.uartlocal.upload.params.verbose=
tools.uartlocal.upload.params.quiet=
tools.uartlocal.upload.pattern="{soclab.python}" "{runtime.platform.path}/tools/uart_upload.py" --bin "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.bin" --port "{serial.port}" --baud 115200

# Automated reset/run still needs a board check. "Upload Using Programmer":
# OpenOCD writes <sketch>.ino.bin at 0xE000_0000, verifies it and resets into the
# boot ROM, which enables XIP and starts the application.
# OpenOCD from PATH unless tools.openocd.path=/.../bin/ (platform.local.txt).
tools.openocd.path=
tools.openocd.cmd=openocd
tools.openocd.config={runtime.platform.path}/tools/openocd_neorv32_jtaghs2.cfg
tools.openocd.program.params.verbose=-d2
tools.openocd.program.params.quiet=
tools.openocd.program.pattern="{path}{cmd}" {program.verbose} -f "{config}" -c "flash write_image erase {{build.path}/{build.project_name}.bin} 0xe0000000 bin" -c "verify_image {{build.path}/{build.project_name}.bin} 0xe0000000 bin" -c "reset run" -c "shutdown"
